goal: Teach woof dispatch to redact secrets and cap audit files at 256 KB before they land on disk, with overflow to a gitignored audit/raw/ path and operator-configurable knobs in .woof/agents.toml.

stories.title: Audit policy contract + config loader
stories.intent: Land the [audit] block on agents.schema.json and a small loader that surfaces enabled/max_bytes/redact_patterns from .woof/agents.toml as a typed config. This is the contract surface S2 consumes; no behavioural change yet.

stories.title: Redactor + size cap wired into woof dispatch
stories.intent: Apply conservative secret redaction and the per-file size cap to every audit artefact written by woof dispatch, overflowing oversized output to a gitignored .woof/epics/E*/audit/raw/ path. Realises end-to-end disk-level redaction and truncation.
